EDITORIAL MOTION

Let the pages change. Keep the word.

MATCH CUT makes a newspaper-style text animation by finding a repeated word in article pages and pinning each match to one screen position.

CREATE A NEWSPAPER VIDEO →

A focused page-change effect

Instead of showing a full newspaper sheet, the video frames a closer article excerpt around the target. A soft focus falloff keeps the phrase easy to read while the outer lines stay part of the paper-like scene. The organic yellow marker follows the target box found by text recognition.

At each edit point, one page fragment gives way to another. The target is aligned before rendering, so it stays centered without a push-in, shake, or slide. The resulting rhythm suits explainers, short editorial videos, and vertical social clips.

FINDSearch accessible article text for the phrase.
FRAMEAlign the OCR match and draw a paper-like stroke.
CHANGECut to the next page on the shared timeline.

What appears in the finished file

The default export is a 9:16 H.264 MP4 with AAC audio. You can set a short duration and choose among paper, documentary, cinematic, marker, impact, or minimal sound treatments. Actual usable matches vary with the word and available public pages; generated editorial pages are identified in the source notes.
